text:
maya: Quick check — planning to announce tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need final changelog snippet, docs URL, bench blurb for the blog, plus confirmation on webinar slot (Wed 9am PT) and inbound lead routing. Can eng confirm canary timing and if we should mention fallback model?

 tj: We can do canary. Plan: 10% at T+10m, 50% at T+1h, full at T+3h if metrics stable. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412. Docs staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.2 (pending last MD commit).

 alex: Bench summary ready — saw ~20% p95 improvement when using adaptive batching on our test corpus. I'll craft a short blurb, 1–2 sentences.

 zoe: Docs updated with new API examples; need eng approval on the example request/response. @tj can you sign off?

 tj: Signing off now. Small note: the KV cache warm-start patch landed this morning — should call that out in the changelog. Also deploy config:

 ```
 canary:
   fraction: 0.10
 monitor:
   latency_p95: "<350ms"
   error_rate: "<0.5%"
 rollback_on: error_rate > 0.5% for 5m
 ```

 deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by @tj at 2024-05-12T17:00:00Z. Monitoring hooks attached.

 olivia: Lead routing: we'll tag inbound forms with campaign=release_may24 and route through Marketo -> SFDC. See ops doc: https://internal.redwood/ops/lead-routing. Need webhook confirmation from platform.

 sam: Webhook endpoint tested end-to-end. Payload includes campaign and utm params, SFDC mapping verified for campaign and source.

 maya: Excellent. Final checklist: alex please drop bench blurb by 2pm PT; tj paste final changelog snippet we can paste into the blog; zoe confirm docs slug. I'll lock announce at 6pm PT if all green. :thumbsup:

 alex: Blurb in doc (link): https://docs.google.com/.. — "With adaptive batching, we reduced p95 latency by ~20% while maintaining throughput and lowering cost per token." Feel free to shorten.

 tj: Changelog snippet for blog: "Fixed multi-tenant routing issue for batching, improved KV cache warm-start for faster cold requests, and added safe rollback on elevated error rates during canaries."

 zoe: Docs slug confirmed: /release/v1.2 — API examples approved and tested against staging.

 maya: Locking announce at 6pm PT. We'll include the bench blurb and the changelog snippet above. Webinar slot confirmed (Wed 9am PT) and inbound routing hooked. Thanks all :tada:
